source_title: Press Note - Daily Enforcement Seizures during 17th Lok Sabha General Election (MCC)
justification: Per-event self-contained file (datasets/elections/parliament/election=*/mcc_seizures.csv) carrying the ECI's MCC-period daily enforcement-seizures press note as a 13-column long-format CSV (state_slug, date, 9 measurement columns, source_id, processing_level). Mints no new meadow-tier indicator; the file is a citizen-facing exhibit (one file per general election) parallel to the per-event candidacies.csv / summary.csv files already present under parliament/election=*. The pre-flight gate is run for documentation completeness per the plan-doc DoD; verdict mint_new expected (no existing concept covers MCC-window enforcement seizures). Update cadence 1825 days = once per 5-year general-election cycle.
